scope: Near-simultaneous bursts of the same state-changing request (redeem, transfer, vote, withdraw, apply-discount) timed to win a check-then-act race.
label_rule: Deciding evidence: idempotency and resulting state. Legitimate: the same burst of identical requests, but one idempotency key enforced (replayed responses) or a route whose operation is idempotent, and the resulting state counters show a single effect within the limit.
